MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for Default Prove-Up Hearing this day.
Dept. 218, Comm. Sue Kaplan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha/Gina Gonzales, CSR: Jacqueline Chan.
Edward A. Kunnes, Esq. for Plaintiff: Fidelity National Title Company with Witness: Gail Gaffney, present, sworn and examined.

Principal $130,317.83
Prejudgment Interest $16,386.30
Costs $503.58, for a total of $147,207.71
Judgment signed in open court.
Counsel stipulated for the return of the Exhibits in court.
